title: test(auth): ratchet the README preview-mode provenance claim to its spec symbol
body:
Part of #6748 — deliberately not a closing keyword: the README correction itself is still owed at the spec-18 bump, so the card stays open.

## What this does

Adds one assertion to `packages/auth/src/__tests__/auth-spec-parity.test.ts` that watches `PreviewModeConfig`, plus a changeset. **No source file, no published behaviour, and no README change.**

## Why it is a ratchet and not the documentation fix

`packages/auth/README.md:328` says the `AuthProvider` preview-mode prop "aligns with the `PreviewModeConfig` from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`". I verified that sentence is **still true** on the spec this repo resolves, so it was left alone:

- The lockfile resolves `@objectstack/spec@17.2.0` for every workspace package (single lockfile, no `pnpm-workspace.yaml` override, no catalog, no private registry).
- 17.2.0 exports `PreviewModeConfig`, `PreviewModeConfigParsed` and `PreviewModeConfigSchema` from its `./kernel` barrel, and `RuntimeMode` still carries the `'preview'` value.
- The artifact I read was verified to be the one actually installed: the tarball's sha512 is byte-identical to the integrity recorded in `pnpm-lock.yaml`.

Upstream retired the symbol in **source** (objectstack#11846, landed as objectstack PR #12718 on 2026-08-28) and registered it as `kernel/PreviewModeConfig` in `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[18]`, so it leaves the **published** set at spec major 18. The latest published spec is still 17.2.0 (2026-08-23), five days before that merge.

Rewriting line 328 now would make it wrong in the *opposite* direction for the whole remaining life of 17.x — telling readers there is no upstream anchor while the import still resolves. So the deliverable is the signal rather than the edit: **this assertion goes red at the spec-18 bump, the exact moment the sentence stops being true**, and its failure message says to correct the README line and then delete the guard.

## Why a standalone assertion rather than a `RENAMES` entry

`RENAMES` entries are `[local dialect name, the spec name it collided with, what the spec's symbol means]`. `PreviewModeConfig` is neither a rename nor a collision — this package declares no local symbol by that name — so the tuple would have misdescribed the relationship. The standalone shape at the bottom of the file (the `AuthProvider` exemption pin) was the honest template.

## The capability is untouched

`AuthProvider`'s `previewMode` prop, `AuthContext.previewMode`, `useAuth().previewMode` and `PreviewBanner` are host-supplied and unchanged; objectui#6654's ruling leaves them intact. Only the provenance sentence is at stake, and only later.

## Verification

Gate union re-run at the final commit `11e9de305`, tree clean:

| gate | verdict line |
|---|---|
| `vitest run packages/auth/src/__tests__/auth-spec-parity.test.ts` | `Tests  15 passed (15)` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth run type-check` | exit 0 (both halves, incl. `tsconfig.test.json`) |
| `check:control-bytes` | `check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 5648 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` |
| `check:spec-symbols` | `spec symbol derivation: 1317 files scanned against 4959 spec export names; 13 declared dialects, 3 untriaged collisions in 1 packages.` |

**The new assertion is measured, not vacuous.** `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit --listFiles` shows the file 1 time, so typecheck genuinely covers it (the package's plain `tsc --noEmit` excludes `**/*.test.ts`, which alone would have been NOT MEASURED). Verbose vitest lists the test by name.

**Ablation — the ratchet provably fires.** With the guard committed, the watched name was repointed at a symbol the spec does not export. Mutation confirmed on disk before running (real anchor 1 to 0, injected marker 0 to 1, blob hash moved off the `HEAD` blob). Result: exactly one failure, mine, carrying my message — `Tests  1 failed | 14 passed (15)`. Restored via `git checkout HEAD --`, proven by state rather than exit code: disk hash back to the `HEAD` blob `d6f791bf`, `git diff HEAD` empty, marker count 0. Re-run green. `node_modules` was never mutated — pnpm hardlinks into a store shared with other agents' worktrees.
